basic_info.description: Amazing value! Tremendous growth potential awaits just a stone's throw from the vibrant "Heart of the Mission," affectionately known as Calle 24. This bustling neighborhood boasts a rich tapestry of lively murals, delectable dining options, and distinctive boutiques. The property is a duplex, comprising a lower unit with 2 bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms, complete with a washer/dryer, and an upper unit featuring 3 bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. Both kitchens were upgraded with granite countertops and stylish wooden cabinetry. Additionally, the property offers the convenience of a spacious two-car tandem garage on the ground floor, and a generous storage space. Note that square footage of units are approximate only.
